description: This file implements the SQL store for managing 'Scheme' entities in the Mattermost server, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and counting schemes, along with role management within schemes.

classes.name: SqlSchemeStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the store for schemes, including methods for CRUD operations and role management.

methods.name: newSqlSchemeStore
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new SqlSchemeStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Creates or updates a scheme in the database, handling transaction management and role creation.

methods.name: createScheme
methods.description: Internal method to create a new scheme, generate IDs, fetch default roles, create default roles, and insert the scheme into the database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme by its ID.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme by its name.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a scheme by its ID, updating related teams/channels and deleting associated roles.

methods.name: GetAllPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of schemes filtered by scope.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all schemes from the database.

methods.name: CountByScope
methods.description: Counts the number of schemes within a specific scope.

methods.name: CountWithoutPermission
methods.description: Counts schemes that do not have a specific permission in their roles.
